olympic.name: Olympic
olympic.description: Increase jump height by {{blocks}}. Take {{damage;%}} less damage while in the air.

soothsayer.name: Soothsayer
soothsayer.description: Weapon right clicks have a {{blue;%}} chance to perform {{blue}} random rune.

moonveil.name: Moonveil
moonveil.description: Increase your crit chance by {{damage;%}} while under damage-preventing effects.

voidcarver.name: Voidcarver
voidcarver.description: Allies within {{blocks}} have their cooldowns tick down {{blue;%}} faster.

gravemind.name: Gravemind
gravemind.description: Kills have a {{blue;%}} chance to summon an allied mob for {{ticks}}.

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.description: Your summoned mobs deal {{damage;%}} more damage and have {{speed;%}} more speed. Summons are guaranteed to be Aspects.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: For every mob on the field, increase your damage by {{damage;%}}.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: Allies within {{blocks}} take {{damageReduction;%}} reduced damage. Doubled below {{heal;%}} health.

ghostly.name: Ghostly
ghostly.description: {{blue;%}} of attacks are dodged. Each dodge grants {{damage;%}} damage and healing for {{ticks}}, up to {{blue}} stacks.

bellicose.name: Bellicose
bellicose.description: For every {{damage}} max health, increase your melee damage by {{damage;%}}.

encumber.name: Encumber
encumber.description: Gain {{blue}} extra charge on your blue rune ability.

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.description: When you fall below {{damage;%}} health, charge for 2 seconds and explode for {{damage;%}} of your max health as damage. Has a cooldown of {{ticks}}.

decay.name: Decay
decay.description: {{gold;%}} chance to inflict a random debuff on enemies for {{ticks}} when taking or dealing damage.

multiply.name: Multiply
multiply.description: For every {{energy}} max energy, gain {{damage;%}} crit multiplier.

silentExecution.name: Silent Execution
silentExecution.description: Attacking an enemy from behind causes your hits to deal {{damage;%}} more damage.

swift.name: Swift
swift.description: For every {{energy;%}} movement speed, gain {{damage;%}} crit chance on your primary attack.

madrakan.name: Madrakan
madrakan.description: Increase your damage by {{damage;%}} but you can no longer land critical hits.

ironChains.name: Iron Chains
ironChains.description: Increase your damage reduction by {{damageReduction;%}} but reduce your movement speed by {{speed;%}}.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.description: Passive health regeneration is always active, but its interval is twice as long.

horizonThreat.name: Horizon Threat
horizonThreat.description: Enemies farther than {{blocks}} take {{damage;%}} increased damage from you, but enemies closer than {{blocks}} deal {{damage;%}} more damage to you.

durable.name: Durable
durable.description: +{{ticks}} to your blue rune skill's ability duration.

cell.name: Cell
cell.description: -{{energy}} ability energy cost on your primary skill.

lean.name: Lean
lean.description: +{{blocks;%}} ability range on your orange rune skill.

axe.name: Axe
axe.description: +{{blue;%}} ability cooldown reduction on your purple rune skill.
